item.title: Amazon now wants to deliver your essentials in 30 minutes
item.description: Non-Prime folks its $13.99 per order, plus a $1.99 small-order fee if your cart doesn’t hit $15.

item.title: Google blends AI Overviews with AI Mode in Search
item.description: For now, the experiment is rolling out globally only on mobile.

item.title: You can now buy in-game items directly on Discord
item.description: The new features include a built-in shop for digital items, wishlists things, and send in-game gifts directly through DMs.

item.description: Cue the dystopian jokes and a few, “I didn’t pay $200 for this.”

item.title: Mixpanel’s data breach surprise raises a lot of questions
item.description: Because OpenAI uses Mixpanel to analyze developer-facing website traffic, the breach likely exposed data from developers relying on OpenAI’s APIs.

item.title: Spotify Wrapped 2025: How to actually get yours (and what to do with it)
item.description: Get ready to unwrap your musical identity with Spotify's 2025 Wrapped! Discover new features like listening age and clubs, top artists race, and archived moments.

item.title: Windows 11 leads, yet a billion PCs continue with Windows 10
item.description: Windows 11 is taking the lead in the OS race, but strict hardware demands and user habits mean nearly a billion PCs are still happily running Windows 10.

item.title: Apple’s head of UI design poached by Meta
item.description: Alan Dye oversee design across hardware, software, and AI integration.

item.title: Russia pulls the plug on Roblox in LGBTQ crackdown
item.description: Russia's communications agency flagged Roblox for containing LGBTQ content, which it classifies as “extremist activity.”

item.title: ChatGPT could become your health coach with Apple Health
item.description: When (or if) it arrives, it would sit under ChatGPT’s “Apps & Connectors” tab, right alongside cloud storage and productivity tools.
